evals.prompt: Find the email pattern for anthropic.com
evals.expected_output: JSON with domain=anthropic.com, a non-empty inferred_patterns list (or a principled low-evidence fallback), and no guesses array (no name supplied).
expectations: `inferred_patterns` is a list with at least one entry
`guesses` is an empty list (no first/last provided)

evals.prompt: Guess Jane Doe's email at stripe.com
evals.expected_output: JSON with domain=stripe.com, name.first=Jane, name.last=Doe, guesses array with 1-3 candidates. Top guess most commonly `jane.doe@stripe.com` (the global prior) but may reflect discovered evidence.
expectations: Every guess has a `confidence` field matching one of: high, medium, low — no evidence

evals.prompt: What's the email for Pat Smith at some-tiny-co-xyz.example
evals.expected_output: JSON with cold-domain fallback — no evidence discovered, 3 prior-based guesses, pat.smith@some-tiny-co-xyz.example first.
expectations: `discovered_emails` is an empty list OR all entries have source_type=serp and confidence is low
Every guess confidence equals `low — no evidence`

evals.prompt: Find the email pattern for main.nl (Main Capital Partners)
evals.expected_output: JSON showing a high-confidence pattern from the RocketReach aggregator snippet. Regression case: aggregator signal must still promote to `high` when share-% >= 60.
expectations: `aggregator_hits` is a list with at least one entry
At least one entry in `inferred_patterns` has confidence `high`

evals.prompt: Find the email pattern for arcadeagroup.com
evals.expected_output: JSON showing pattern inference with the sentinel-placeholder blacklist in effect. Regression case: `last@arcadeagroup.com` is a LeadIQ pattern-example placeholder and must NOT appear in discovered_emails.
expectations: No entry in `discovered_emails` has email equal to `last@arcadeagroup.com`
No entry in `discovered_emails` has email equal to `first@arcadeagroup.com`
No entry in `discovered_emails` has email equal to `firstlast@arcadeagroup.com`
At least one inferred pattern has confidence `medium` or `high`

evals.prompt: Find the email pattern for tributetech.com
evals.expected_output: JSON showing pattern inference with the expanded ROLE_LOCALS filter in effect. Regression case: `websites@tributetech.com` is a role account, not a named employee.
expectations: If `websites@tributetech.com` appears in `discovered_emails`, its `role_account` field is true
If `accounting@tributetech.com` appears in `discovered_emails`, its `role_account` field is true
At least one inferred pattern has confidence `medium` or `high`

evals.prompt: Find the email pattern for vistaequitypartners.com
evals.expected_output: JSON showing pattern inference using bare-word split credit. Regression case: domains where all harvested named emails are bare words (no `.`, `-`, or `_`) should still score via 0.5/0.5 split credit between `{first}` and `{last}`.
expectations: `inferred_patterns` has at least one entry with confidence `medium` OR `high`
The top-ranked pattern is one of `{first}`, `{last}`, or `{first}.{last}`

evals.prompt: Guess Jonathan Chen's email at arcadeagroup.com
evals.expected_output: JSON with guesses rendered from canonicalized name. Regression case: name-seeded SERP queries should augment evidence but must not be cached under the domain-only key.
expectations: Every guess email contains `jonathan` or `chen` or `j` (rendered from the canonicalized name, not the literal sentinels `first`/`last`)
